Best HomeKit Cameras 2025: Complete Comparison Guide

A comprehensive comparison of HomeKit-compatible security cameras tested over 6 months. Find the perfect camera for your Apple smart home.

This article compares three HomeKit-compatible security cameras tested over 6 months:

Eve Indoor Cam ($99)

Best for simplicity with native HomeKit, privacy shutter, but requires iCloud+ subscription for recording.

Aqara G4 Doorbell ($129)

Recommended as best overall with native HomeKit Secure Video, SD card storage (no subscription), and local face recognition.

Eufy S350 ($129)

Offers 4K quality and auto-tracking but requires a bridge and separate app for full functionality.

Our Recommendation

The Aqara G4 is the top pick for 2025 due to its balance of:

  • Native HomeKit integration
  • No subscription requirement
  • Local privacy features

Key Drawbacks to Consider

  • Eve: Requires paid iCloud+
  • Eufy: Needs a bridge for full functionality
  • Aqara: Requires wired doorbell installation
